injection_recovery.method: shift the TEMPLATE per epoch; shifting observations is 92% absorbed by the telluric anchor
injection_recovery.verdict: control overturned; 7 sigma disagreement with the target's own measurement

retractions: A-B is NOT a sufficient metric: it implied 66 +/- 23 m/s per night (0.36 sigma from the paper) but the direct comparison to published RVs gives 387 m/s. It probes only 10 minutes; per-order zero points drift between nights.
The archive route is NOT structurally broken by A/B merging: cr2res resamples B onto A's grid before summing (19/21 segments favour the resampled model).
The repeated build failures were NOT a pty deadlock; the WSL service was crashing (Wsl/Service/E_UNEXPECTED).

closed_suspects.adp_to_cr2res_conversion: correct -- every viper order maps to a segment matching ESO's own INS WLEN CWLENn
closed_suspects.tpl_wave_tell: no-op for RV runs; read only inside `if createtpl:`

open.residual: per-order zero points drifting night to night; 387 m/s vs 54 m/s needed
open.note: the anchor screen fixes 10-minute repeatability (2-3x) without improving Eq.1, which is why it does not close the gap
